PREVALENCE: no free source gives US survival of infantile-onset patients to age 18 on enzyme therapy, so the under-18 stock cannot be built from the incidence above without inventing a survival curve; the ceiling, every case surviving, is 23 x 18 = 420, written here as context and not as a row. ELIGIBLE: ROSSELLA admits ERT-experienced children only after 'a clinical decline on their current rhGAA dose', and excludes invasive ventilation and untreated CRIM-negative infants; no free source gives those shares in the US. PRICE: CMS 2024 holds Pombiliti in Part B ($2.69mm, 13 beneficiaries) and Part D ($5.80mm, 13 beneficiaries), adults only, and the drug is dosed at 20 mg/kg, so an adult claim says nothing about a child's cost without an age and weight mix no free source gives. PENETRATION: no infantile-onset uptake of any enzyme therapy is reported separately by any filer.
